# firezone_oidc_auth_provider (Resource)

Firezone OIDC Auth Provider resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 Client ID
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 Client Secret
- `discovery_document_uri` (String) OIDC Discovery Document URI
- `name` (String) Provider name

### Optional

- `client_session_lifetime_secs` (Number) Client session lifetime in seconds (optional)
- `context` (String) Where the provider can be used: clients_and_portal, clients_only, portal_only
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default provider
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is disabled
- `portal_session_lifetime_secs` (Number) Portal session lifetime in seconds (optional)
- `scope` (String) OAuth2 scope (optional, e.g., 'openid email profile')

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Provider ID
